presentation.label: MIDI CC to effect page 2
presentation.summary: Map incoming MIDI CC 68–73 to FX1 page-2 parameters. The upstream FX2 block requires BusDelay or BusVerb, outside Octamod's scope.
presentation.overview: CC Map maps incoming MIDI CCs on audio tracks' trig channels to effect page-2 parameters, respecting AUDIO CC IN and clamping values. It writes Part, live and shadow values and marks the Part changed. This source draft is unavailable until qualification, LCD evidence, integration and owner review are complete.
highlights: CC 68–73 address FX1 page-2 slots 6–11 for a non-NONE FX1.
Writes every audio track whose trig channel matches the message.
Clamps values using the target effect's parameter limits.
Passes CCs outside 62–73 to the next handler.
usage: After qualification, enable AUDIO CC IN and match the controller's channel to the target audio track's trig channel.
Select a non-NONE FX1 and send CC 68–73 to its second-page slots; verify the parameter, sound and Part save/reload behavior.
Exact panel/menu paths and actual LCD captures remain required before publication.

access.location: Incoming MIDI control of audio-track FX1 page 2, enabled by AUDIO CC IN; exact panel/menu access awaits hardware/LCD verification.
steps: In a qualified local build, enable AUDIO CC IN in the project's MIDI control settings; confirm the exact button/menu path with actual LCD captures before publication.
Assign the target audio track a trig channel matching the external controller.
Select a non-NONE FX1 effect and inspect its second-page parameters; the exact effect-page button sequence remains unverified for this draft.
Send CC 68–73 to page-2 slots 6–11 with values within the selected effect's documented limits.
Verify the expected control and sound change and that Part save/reload retains the value.

limitations: Draft only: unavailable in the catalog and firmware builds pending qualification, LCD evidence, integration and owner approval.
CC 62–67 write FX2 page 2 only for BusDelay/BusVerb, which are outside scope and not imported. Current catalog/stock FX2 support is not claimed.
CC 62–73 are consumed even if AUDIO CC IN is disabled or the track's effect has no eligible target.
All Octamod combinations and hook/placement behavior are unverified, including MIDI Scenes, Scale Quantizer, OctaKit and USB MIDI/Audio.
Upstream MODE DEFAULTS and SCENES KITS overrides are not imported or enabled.
Upstream leaves hardware SCENES KITS chaining and FX1-to-DSP updates on THRU tracks open.
